description: Platform for building online stores, managing products, orders, and payments via REST and GraphQL APIs
access_requirements: Free dev store self‑serve; production requires a Shopify subscription
evidence_excerpts: All REST Admin API queries require a valid Shopify access token.
Public and custom apps created in the Dev Dashboard generate tokens using OAuth, and custom apps made in the Shopify admin are authenticated in the Shopify admin.
Include your token as a `X-Shopify-Access-Token` header on all API queries.
The REST Admin API is a legacy API as of October 1, 2024. Starting April 1, 2025, all new public apps must be built exclusively with the GraphQL Admin API.
The Admin API lets you build apps and integrations that extend and enhance the Shopify admin.
